string_hints: CyberVoice E-mail is a Windows 95 / NT application that replaces typed text e-mail messages with direct speech. The recorded voice messages are compressed to a very small fraction of their original data size using a proprietary, state-of-the-art speech compression technology. The compressed voice messages, together with optional text and images, are then sent via user-selected e-mail system over the Internet. The very small size of compressed voice messages make Internet transmission and PC storage very efficient and economical. Once received, the voice messages can be played back, with high quality and in real time, with just a single click of the mouse.

CyberVoice Compression is a state-of-the-art voice compression algorithm developed by Cybernetics InfoTech, Inc., of Gaithersburg, Maryland, a company specializing in digital voice/audio compression and related applications. Based on in-depth knowledge of human voice production and perception processes and advanced digital speech modeling and quantization technologies, CyberVoice Compression delivers high-quality digital voice at very low data rate.

. Compared to the original speech (at 128 kbit/s), CyberVoice Compression achieves a compression ratio of 25.6:1. At the same time, CyberVoice Compression maintains compressed speech quality as good as wireline telephony speech (equal to or better than ADPCM at 32 kbit/s). The compression and decompression speed are both very fast.

The purpose of attaching a player is to let the recipient to listen to your voice message, even if he or she does not have CyberVoice E-mail software. The voice file with the player attached is a self-extractable file, i.e. it is a executable file (.EXE). To listen to the voice, just run this file as you do with any other DOS executable files. If you wish to save the voice message for later use, save the voice message either as a Wave file (.WAV) or CyberVoice file (.CBV) instead of .EXE.

If you want to send your voice message via a MAPI-compatible e-mail system, you must set this e-mail system as the default (host) e-mail system. Otherwise Microsoft Exchange will always be the default e-mail system. If you want to set CyberVoice E-mail system as a stand-alone e-mail system, you can always select the existing e-mail system as OTHERS. When you select the e-mail system other than MS Exchange, cc:Mail or Eudora mail, you need to set up your e-mail host information.
